query: WITH w AS ( SELECT e.sent_at, CASE WHEN e.status = 'completed' THEN e.completed_at END AS done_at FROM envelopes AS e WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM envelope_states AS s WHERE s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.envelope_id = e.id) AND e.created_at >= $2 AND e.created_at < $3 AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR e.sender_user_id = $4)), d AS ( SELECT to_char((sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + make_interval(mins => $5), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, 1 AS sent, 0 AS completed FROM w WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT to_char((done_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + make_interval(mins => $5), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 0, 1 FROM w WHERE done_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT day AS "day!", sum(sent)::int8 AS "sent!", sum(completed)::int8 AS "completed!" FROM d GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
